description:
FILED s518e (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) from the Type-Tiny census sample: t/21-types/Any.t (perl 72/0) dies at transpile:

    Parser2 TODO: self-referential init: my @none_tests =
    ...
    	pass => 'filehandle' => do { open my $x, '<', $0 or die; $x },

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs main ff4c1500):

    my @n = my @t = (1, do { my $x = 2; $x });
    print "@n|@t\n";

perl: `1 2|1 2`.  PCL: the whole file refuses.  Pl/Parser2.pm ~10809: the chained-`my` path dies when the final initializer TEXT matches /(?<![-\w])(?:my|our|local|state)\b/ -- a textual test that cannot tell a `my` scoped inside a nested block (harmless) from a self-referential one.  NOT fixed (the declaration/rename family -- the sweep is the gate for a change there).  One file in the census (the other 67 21-types files declare `my @tests` alone).
subject: `my @a = my @b = (LIST)` is refused ("Parser2 TODO: self-referential init") when LIST contains ANY `my` -- even inside a do-block element (`do { open my $x, ... }`); Type-Tiny t/21-types/Any.t does not compile
